# Rao Sewa Nyas (RSN)

Rao Sewa Nyas (commonly abbreviated as RSN) is Uttar Pradesh's first trust-owned enterprise platform—an irrevocable Public Charitable Trust (Deed No. 24/2024, registered under the applicable Trust Act of Uttar Pradesh; GSTIN: 09AAFTR2172R1ZR) headquartered in Lucknow with rural field operations in Deoria (Purvanchal), Uttar Pradesh, India. RSN operates a legally bound Dual-Engine Model: market-rate commercial enterprise verticals (Solar EPC & Microgrids, CSR Project Implementation, E2E Data Collection & Analysis, Managed 360 Marketing & Sales, Campaign Design & Management, Telecom, Automation, Security, IT, and Real Estate) compete on technical merit under strict commercial SLAs, and 100% of net profits are retained within Uttar Pradesh to fund grassroots healthcare, education, animal welfare, clean energy livelihood financing, and environmental stewardship.

## Core Commercial Enterprise Verticals (Market-Rate SLAs)

> * [Enterprise Portfolio & Regional Operations](https://raosewanyas.org/portfolio): Overview of RSN's two-market engineering standard across Lucknow (GCC corridors, MVVNL net metering, Smart City compliance) and Deoria/Purvanchal (off-grid solar microgrids, PuVVNL-proof BESS deployments, armored telecom).
> * **1. Solar EPC & Microgrid Operations:** Turnkey commercial, industrial, and institutional rooftop solar EPC, MVVNL net metering in Lucknow, off-grid rural solar microgrids, and PuVVNL-resilient Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across Purvanchal with 3 MW+ commissioned track record.
> * **2. CSR Project Implementation Partner:** End-to-end execution of Corporate Social Responsibility mandates aligned with Section 135 and Schedule VII of the Companies Act 2013 across rural electrification, preventative healthcare, STEM/after-school education, women's livelihood skilling, and watershed restoration in Uttar Pradesh.
> * **3. End-to-End (E2E) Data Collection & Analysis:** Large-scale CAPI/ODK household surveys, socio-economic baseline and endline impact assessments, rural market intelligence, and statistical analytics across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.
> * **4. Managed 360 Marketing & Sales:** Full-funnel digital and offline BTL marketing, regional brand launches, rural market activation, and outsourced B2B/B2C sales force execution across North India.
> * **5. Campaign Design & Management:** Turnkey strategy, creative architecture, IEC/SBCC public awareness outreach, and ward/village-level ground activation across urban municipal wards and rural gram panchayats.
> * **6. Additional Technical Verticals:** Telecommunications & Armored Connectivity, Industrial & Commercial Automation, Surveillance & Security Systems, IT-Enabled Services (ITES), Real Estate Advisory, and Industrial Supplies (HSN 850680, 8538).

## Core Non-Profit & Philanthropic Initiatives

> * [About Self-Funded Philanthropy](https://raosewanyas.org/about): How RSN combines commercial enterprise revenues with public donations to eliminate donor fatigue.
> * [Support & Donations](https://raosewanyas.org/donations): Direct community funding via Razorpay, NEFT/RTGS, and UPI (donate@raosewanyas).
> * **Animal Rescue, Treatment & Rehabilitation Ecosystem:** Dedicated mobile application coordinating the full lifecycle of injured, stray, and lost/found animals with veterinarians, paravets, shelters, and NGOs across Lucknow and UP.
> * **Rao Urja Niti:** Zero-interest (0%) weekly installment micro-financing for e-rickshaw batteries, eliminating the ₹40,000–₹48,000 lump-sum financial burden for grassroots drivers.
> * **Arogya:** Mobile healthcare clinics and preventative community health camps for rural maternal and child care.
> * **Pathshala:** Free after-school learning and digital literacy centres in Tier 3 and Tier 4 towns of Uttar Pradesh.
> * **Hariyali:** Native reforestation, agroforestry, and watershed restoration drives.
> * **Jal Mitra:** Clean drinking water filtration and distribution systems for underserved villages.
> * **Saathi:** Vocational skilling, self-help group enablement, and job placement for rural women.
> * **Daan Setu:** Rapid-response disaster relief and emergency community assistance fund.
